settingsPrivacyPolicyContent:
Privacy Policy – IBITI Guardian

Last updated: 2026

IBITI Guardian is a mobile security tool designed to help users analyze token approvals and identify potential risks associated with smart-contract permissions.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

We do not collect or store:
• Private keys
• Seed phrases
• Wallet passwords
• Personal identity information

2. Wallet Address Usage

The public wallet address is processed locally for risk analysis only and is not stored on any server.

3. Blockchain Data

We read publicly available blockchain data through third-party RPC providers. All this data already exists publicly on the blockchain.

4. Local Storage

The app may store settings, language preferences, and monitoring configuration locally. No sensitive credentials are stored.

5. Security

All security analysis is performed using publicly available blockchain information.

6. Contact

For support or questions: info@ibiticoin.com
settingsTermsOfServiceContent:
Terms of Service – IBITI Guardian

Last updated: 2026

By using IBITI Guardian, you agree to the following terms.

1. Description

IBITI Guardian is a blockchain security analysis tool that helps users scan token approvals, identify risky permissions, and revoke them through their connected wallet. It is not a cryptocurrency wallet and does not hold user funds.

2. User Responsibility

Users are fully responsible for protecting their private keys and verifying transactions before signing.

3. No Financial Advice

All information is for security analysis purposes only and is not financial or legal advice.

4. Blockchain Risks

Blockchain interactions involve inherent risks. IBITI Guardian attempts to detect potential risks but cannot guarantee complete protection.

5. Limitation of Liability

IBITI Guardian and its developers are not liable for any financial loss or damages resulting from the use of the application.

6. Contact: info@ibiticoin.com
settingsDisclaimerContent:
Disclaimer – IBITI Guardian

Last updated: 2026

1. No Custody of Funds

IBITI Guardian does not hold, store, or control user funds. All transactions are executed directly through the user's connected wallet.

2. No Access to Private Keys

We never request or store private keys, seed phrases, or wallet passwords.

3. Informational Purposes Only

All information is for security purposes only and is not financial, investment, or legal advice.

4. Blockchain Risks

Blockchain transactions are irreversible. We attempt to detect risks but cannot guarantee complete protection against all threats.

5. Limitation of Liability

We are not responsible for financial losses resulting from blockchain interactions.

6. Contact: info@ibiticoin.com

aiPinConfirmOffWarnBody: In «Autonomous» mode the AI will place orders, swaps and sends by itself, without the card and the PIN. It still stays within the daily limit, the «AI Mandate» and EPK, and sends only to trusted addresses. A new address still asks for your PIN; an operation with an unknown price is not done by the AI — it opens the filled window for you to confirm. After each action you get the «AI did: …» notification.
aiPinConfirmNotifOffBody: Android blocks notifications for the app, so you will not get «AI did: …» after the AI acts. Turn them on in Android settings → Apps → Guardian → Notifications. Every AI action is still written to the audit log.

marketScoutNoteAdvisor: «Advisor» mode: I only advise — I analyse, compare and explain the market. I open, prepare and execute nothing (no windows, orders, watchlist or alerts). To let me act, switch to «Manual» or «Autonomous» in AI Center.
marketScoutNoteManual: «Manual» mode: I build buy/sell plans and prepare the order or swap window for {assets} on {networks}. Allowed actions: {actions}. You check it and confirm with your PIN — nothing runs without you.
marketScoutNoteAutoPin: «Autonomous» mode: I carry out the trades you ask for, within your mandate: {assets} on {networks}. Allowed actions: {actions}. Daily limit: {daily}. PIN confirmation is on: each trade first shows a card and asks your PIN. A wallet trade of a coin without a USD price I never carry out myself: I open the filled-in wallet window, and you confirm it there with your PIN. Limits, policy and EPK hold on every trade; I never trade on my own without your request.
marketScoutNoteAutoNoPin: «Autonomous» mode: I carry out the trades you ask for, within your mandate: {assets} on {networks}. Allowed actions: {actions}. Daily limit: {daily}; one buy at most {cap}. PIN confirmation is off: I act without the card only when all of this holds: within the daily limit and the «AI Mandate», EPK protection on, a trusted recipient (a trusted address or contract, or your own wallet), a known USD price, and the app open with the wallet unlocked. A new address, a locked wallet or an exchange order while EPK is paused: I ask you first — the card and your PIN. A wallet trade of a coin without a USD price I never carry out myself: I open the filled-in wallet window, and you confirm it there with your PIN. While EPK is paused I do nothing on-chain. Over a limit or outside the mandate I refuse; to allow more, raise the limit in «Policy» (needs your PIN). After each trade you get the notification «AI did: …». I never go over a limit and never trade on my own without your request.
